walkthrough: Goal: a beginner with half an hour sits down for a unit's full lesson: a short warm-up, then each skill of the unit, on the day's sheet; a phone call in the middle does not lose it.

Entry: after the first lesson, Home, All units. The path page offers, under To practise longer, the unit's full lesson: About 21 minutes (the minutes its exercises take, the offer's own) and Full lesson, with A warm-up, then each skill of this unit.

Full lesson: the day's sheet takes it on its next row, labelled Lesson 2 · Full lesson, unit 1; the bar says Warm-up 1/3 and no How shows (a warm-up never brings one). I copy the warm-up's line, Compare, Accurate; Next, Next.
After the warm-up the bar names the unit's first skill and its own count, Lines 1/6, and Lines' How shows by itself the first time; Got it. I copy the line, Compare, Almost; Next: Lines 2/6.
Cancel mid-lesson: Home. The home says Today's lesson, under way: Full lesson 5/15, and Continue (no Review: no redo yet). Continue: the same sheet opens at Lines 2/6, the strokes as left.

Next through Lines, Combined lines (its How the first time; Got it) and Colours (its How; Got it), each named in the bar with its own count, to Finish: the end says Full lesson, unit 1 by its row, its exercises and time, the results in a row (Accurate, Almost, the rest not judged), no skill's dots (a full lesson holds several), One more with what it starts and That's all for today, which leaves for the home.
Not here: a full lesson of a later unit (the app's tests); the half hour itself on the tablet.
